settings.fallback_note: Used when fewer than 2 periods are logged
settings.app_lock_note: Require Face ID or fingerprint to open the app
settings.biometric_unavailable: Biometric authentication is not available or not set up on this device.
settings.reminders_note: Get notified about upcoming periods and daily logging
settings.notifications_denied: Notification permissions were denied. Enable them in your device settings.
settings.backup_note: The backup file isn't encrypted: anyone who has it can read it. It includes your pregnancy photos, so it can be large. Keep it somewhere private.
settings.restore_contents: This file holds {{periods}} and {{days}}, from {{from}} to {{to}}.
settings.restore_kept_one: 1 entry already on this phone stays as it is.
settings.restore_kept_other: {{count}} entries already on this phone stay as they are.
settings.restore_settings: Your settings from the backup will also be applied.
settings.restore_nothing: Everything in this backup is already on this phone.
settings.restore_error_not_json: This isn't a Lumi backup file.
settings.restore_error_not_lumi: This isn't a Lumi backup file.
settings.restore_error_newer_version: This backup was made by a newer version of Lumi. Update the app, then try again.
settings.restore_error_invalid: This backup file is damaged and can't be read. Nothing was changed.
settings.restore_error_failed: The restore failed. Nothing was changed.
settings.export_csv_note: For reading in a spreadsheet. To move your data to another phone, use a backup.
settings.share_unavailable: Sharing isn't available on this device.
settings.file_error: Something went wrong writing the file. Please try again.
settings.delete_note: Permanently erases everything Lumi has stored on this phone.
settings.delete_confirm_body: This deletes {{periods}} and {{days}}, and resets your settings. It can't be undone.
settings.delete_done: All your data has been deleted.
settings.restore_pregnancies_one: It also holds 1 pregnancy, with its visits, moments and photos.
settings.restore_pregnancies_other: It also holds {{count}} pregnancies, with their visits, moments and photos.
settings.restore_missing_photos_one: 1 photo wasn't in the file and couldn't be restored.
settings.restore_missing_photos_other: {{count}} photos weren't in the file and couldn't be restored.

pregnancy.title: Your pregnancy
pregnancy.disclaimer: General information, not medical advice. Your midwife or doctor knows your pregnancy.
pregnancy.prompt_question: Have you taken a pregnancy test?
pregnancy.setup_last_period: First day of your last period
pregnancy.setup_scan_add: I have a due date from a scan
pregnancy.error_future: The first day of your last period can't be in the future.
pregnancy.error_scan_range: This due date doesn't fit your last period. Check both dates.
pregnancy.error_end_date: This date must be after the pregnancy started and not in the future.
pregnancy.recovery_body: Your body is recovering. Bleeding for several weeks after a birth is normal. Rest when you can, and log how you feel.
pregnancy.fertility_warning: You can get pregnant again before your first period comes back.
pregnancy.return_breastfeeding: While breastfeeding, periods often take several months to come back.
pregnancy.return_not_breastfeeding: Without breastfeeding, periods can come back as soon as 5 to 6 weeks after the birth.
pregnancy.period_back_early_body: Bleeding in the first weeks after a birth is usually not a period. Unless you're sure, log it as bleeding on the day instead.
pregnancy.loss_card: We're sorry. Take all the time you need.
pregnancy.loss_body: When your period comes back, log it here and Lumi will start following your cycle again.
pregnancy.settings_remove_note: Started by mistake? This removes it completely.
pregnancy.remove_confirm_body: This removes the pregnancy and everything recorded with it. It can't be undone.
pregnancy.sources_intro: Lumi's weekly notes are written in plain language, in our own words, from the public sources below. Sizes are approximate lengths from the NHS guide; every baby grows at its own pace.
pregnancy.sources_review: These notes have not been reviewed by a midwife or doctor. They are general information, not medical advice: your midwife or doctor knows your pregnancy.
pregnancy.sources_counting: Weeks are counted from the first day of your last period, as most health services do.

journey.title: Your journey
journey.empty: Moments, visits and the symptoms you log will appear here as your pregnancy goes on.
journey.moment_photo_needed: Choose a photo to save this moment.
journey.moment_text_needed: Write a few words to save this note.
journey.error_date: This date must be during the pregnancy.
journey.error_weight: Weight must be between 30 and 250 kg.
journey.error_bp: Blood pressure looks wrong. Check both numbers, or leave both empty.
journey.keep_question: Would you like to keep the Journey from this pregnancy?
journey.delete_journey_body: This deletes its visits, moments and photos. It can't be undone.
journey.read_only: This pregnancy has ended. Its Journey is kept here as it was.
